cli.about: A tiny agent harness that's blazing fast: serves an A2A agent and opens a terminal UI.
cli.arg.bind: Bind the server here instead of [server] bind.
cli.arg.config: The configuration file; written with commented defaults when missing.
cli.arg.locale: The locale for everything shown to a person (default: the configured one, then LANG, then en).
cli.arg.no_tui: No terminal UI: log to standard output.
cli.arg.url: Talk to a harness at this A2A URL instead of starting one.
cli.error.durable_unreachable: durable mode remote is configured but Temporal is unreachable; refusing to start
cli.error.remote_not_supported: --url is accepted but the terminal UI arrives with milestone 5; starting the local harness
cli.error.secret_unresolvable: credential reference {reference} could not be resolved: {reason}
cli.first_run.durable_embedded: durable mode embedded: a Temporal dev server runs in this process (development only; it forgets everything when it stops)
cli.first_run.durable_none: durable mode none: no Temporal configured; tasks will not survive a restart
cli.first_run.durable_remote: durable mode remote: tasks run as Temporal workflows on {address}
cli.first_run.loopback_only: loopback only: no security scheme configured
command.denied: {role, select, watcher {Watchers may not run {name}.} other {Your role may not run {name}.}}
command.effort.description: Set the reasoning effort for the next call: /effort low|medium|high.
command.effort.unknown: Effort must be low, medium or high, not {effort}.
command.exit.bye: Leaving the session; the task stays open.
command.exit.description: Leave the session; the task stays as it is.
command.model.description: Pick the model for the next call: /model <alias>; /model alone lists them.
command.model.unknown: No model is configured as {alias}. Configured: {models}.
task.limit_reached: The task reached its {limit} limit and is waiting for you.
tool.denied: The tool {tool} is not available to your role.
tui.confirm.complete: Complete the task? Sends the task extension's complete message; {n, plural, =0 {no running sub-task is affected} one {# running sub-task will be canceled} other {# running sub-tasks will be canceled}}.
tui.prompt.first_message: Type a message to start a task. Prefix with / for commands.
